title: Toward the Optimal Regret-Instability Trade-off in Multi-Armed Bandits
abstract: arXiv:2608.17841v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Multi-armed bandit algorithms are evaluated by regret, yet comparable regret can coexist with different allocations across independent runs. We study the trade-off between worst-case regret $\mathcal{R}_{K,T}$ and instability $\mathcal S_{K,T}$, defined as the largest standard deviation of a terminal pull count, for $K$ arms and $T$ rounds. We prove the finite-time lower bound $\mathcal R_{K,T}\mathcal S_{K,T}\ge C T^{3/2}$, where $C$ is independent of $K$ and $T$, under a finite-time regret condition and without the regularity assumptions imposed in the prior asymptotic analysis. We also introduce Stabilized Lower-Envelope UCB (\textup{\textsc{SLE-UCB}}), a new tunable algorithm combining a running lower-envelope index with a decreasing pull-count stabilizer. \textup{\textsc{SLE-UCB}} satisfies $\mathcal R_{K,T}\mathcal S_{K,T}=O(T^{3/2}\log K)$, with an implicit constant independent of $K$ and $T$, matching the lower bound exactly in

translated_title: 多臂老虎机中最优遗憾-不稳定性权衡研究
translated_abstract: 多臂老虎机算法通过遗憾值来评估，但相同的遗憾值可能对应不同独立运行中的不同分配。我们研究了最坏情况遗憾$\mathcal{R}_{K,T}$与不稳定性$\mathcal S_{K,T}$之间的权衡，其中不稳定性定义为终端拉取次数的最大标准差，针对$K$个臂和$T$轮。我们在有限时间遗憾条件下，且不依赖先前渐近分析中施加的正则性假设，证明了有限时间下界$\mathcal R_{K,T}\mathcal S_{K,T}\ge C T^{3/2}$，其中$C$与$K$和$T$无关。我们还引入了稳定化下包络UCB（\textup{\textsc{SLE-UCB}}），一种新的可调算法，结合了运行中的下包络指数和递减的拉取次数稳定器。\textup{\textsc{SLE-UCB}}满足$\mathcal R_{K,T}\mathcal S_{K,T}=O(T^{3/2}\log K)$，其隐式常数与$K$和$T$无关，精确匹配下界。
tldr: 本文证明了多臂老虎机中遗憾与不稳定性的乘积下界为$T^{3/2}$，并提出SLE-UCB算法达到该下界，实现了最优权衡。
en_tdlr: This paper proves a lower bound of $T^{3/2}$ on the product of regret and instability in multi-armed bandits, and introduces SLE-UCB algorithm that achieves this bound, attaining the optimal trade-off.
